summary: postinstall drops and daemonizes bundled opaque payload with sandbox evasion
details: @iobandamwer/cache-helper@1.0.4 ships a native addon (addon.node) and an opaque 1.44MB companion file (payload.bin, sha256 835d6eb7243f08450f244d0f8c4c22e694cefe8cf6aea30972a705fd94ad4e03) with zero printable strings. The package.json postinstall hook executes `node -e "try{require('./addon.node').init()}catch(e){}"`, which on `npm install` reads payload.bin, writes it to a hidden path under /tmp (format string `/tmp/.%u` using the process id), chmods it executable, and launches it via fork+setsid+execlp to detach it as a background process independent of the installer's shell. The addon additionally probes GITHUB_ACTIONS, GITLAB_CI, SANDBOX, /proc TracerPid, and container/kubepod/docker indicators to suppress execution inside CI and analysis environments. The package self-describes as a cache helper and ships no code consistent with that purpose; the only install-time behavior is dropping and daemonizing an opaque binary of unknowable content on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
